en: A black‑and‑white image bordered like an old photographic postcard shows a long, straight sidewalk lined with large trees and dense shrubs. On the left is a low wall with metal fencing and lush plantings; on the right young trees are staked beside the walk and a wide, mostly empty street runs parallel. In the distance there are a few detached houses or mansions. The lower border includes some faint, handwritten numbers or letters that appear reversed, as if the image is from a negative.
